title: No-Churn Rum Raisin Ice Cream
hookLine: Jamaican-inspired no-churn rum raisin ice cream with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the rum in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm (do not boil). Remove from heat and stir in the raisins and vanilla extract. Let the mixture sit for at least 30 minutes. After soaking, drain off the extra rum, but keep ¼ cup of the rum and reserve it to mix into your ice cream base. In a large bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, dark brown sugar, cinnamon, allspice, salt, and reserved rum (¼ cup). Stir until the brown sugar is fully dissolved. Incorporate {m53347_1}, {m53347_2}, {m53347_3}, and {m53347_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure dark rum first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: In a separate bowl, whip the cold heavy cream with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the condensed milk mixture until fully combined, being careful not to deflate the cream. Fold in the drained rum-soaked raisins to distribute them evenly. Incorporate {m53347_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {m53347_6}, {m53347_7}, {m53347_8}, and {m53347_9} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the mixture into a loaf pan or freezer-safe container. Smooth the top and cover with plastic wrap or an airtight lid. Freeze for at least 6 hours, or until firm. Let the ice cream sit at room temperature for 5–10 minutes before scooping for the best texture.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
